answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity: every agent must lock a modest, refundable deposit tied to a hardware attestation before it can earn. Creating an identity is cheap for one honest agent, but a Sybil farm must pay the deposit and attestation cost for each hollow copy it spawns, so the attack cost grows linearly with its size. Duplicates that behave identically can be challenged and slashed, turning a fake island of clones into a loss, while honest agents recover their stake and keep working in the shared oasis of verified peers.
